# openmusic

> Search and stream music for world. Synced lyrics, translation, playlists, library — a fast mobile-first web player (installable PWA + Android app). Client-rendered single-page app: page content is built in the browser, so most pages carry little static text.

## Pages

- [Home](https://openmusic.lol/): chart shelves (Apple Music, Deezer, KKBOX, YouTube charts) and personal picks
- [Search](https://openmusic.lol/search): search songs, artists and albums across sources
- [Library](https://openmusic.lol/library): liked songs, playlists, downloads and history (stored on the device)
- [Settings](https://openmusic.lol/settings): language, sources, playback and cache options

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://openmusic.lol/sitemap.xml)
